text:
The court will likely **sustain the objections and exclude the records**. The defendant's bare statement that he kept them "on a regular business basis" is too conclusory to establish the FRE 803(6) business-records foundation, which also requires that the entries were made at or near the time by someone with knowledge. Nor does it authenticate the computer output under FRE 901(b)(9), since nothing shows the system produces accurate results.

CONFIDENCE: 60
